correctness.rationale: For all integers n>=2 and h>=0 the nilpotent shift explicitly yields c_k and b_k. The six-state sign is exactly governed by a strictly increasing quintic. For h<=3, b_k has positive-amplitude sin(k phi+psi) form and phi>pi/12, psi>pi/6, forcing a negative b_k with k<=10; for h>3 c0<0. Exact rational recurrence at h=3 gives c1..c9,b0..b9 positive and hence feasibility through n=11. SymPy replay verified 1701 exact identities/entries. Taylor tests are not substituted for the all-dimensional proof.

value.rationale: A finite stochastic simulation method can have no safe timestep at all on natural absorbing chains of twelve or more states, despite an admissible nondegenerate interval for every smaller chain; the exact six-state window exhibits failure on both the small- and large-step sides. The sharp structural maximum size and exact algebraic boundary provide useful method-selection and positivity tests rather than an arbitrary numerical instance.
